title: Result body
description: A Result is accepted, progress, or exactly one terminal outcome for its Command. A target replays the canonical terminal Result for a repeated Command; a provider acknowledgement or model claim is never a Result.

oneOf.title: Accepted
oneOf.description: The target admitted the Command. Acceptance is not proof of any external effect.

oneOf.title: Progress
oneOf.description: A non-terminal observation about an in-flight Command. Any number may be emitted; none of them settles the Command.

stage.description: The stage reached, for example environment_acquired or checks_running.

detail.description: Structured, redacted progress fields. Never user-facing narration.
detail.$comment: extension-point: the owning Command's area defines its progress detail fields.

oneOf.title: Terminal
oneOf.description: The single canonical terminal outcome. Disposition, side-effect certainty, and any typed failure stay separate fields.

failure.description: Required for every disposition except succeeded, and forbidden for succeeded.

output.description: Typed output of the Command. Area schemas constrain it by payload_type.
output.$comment: extension-point: the owning Command's area defines its typed output fields.

command_disposition.description: The five canonical terminal dispositions for a Command.

oneOf.title: Succeeded
oneOf.description: The Command completed its intended effect.

oneOf.title: Rejected
oneOf.description: The target refused before any side effect, for example on a revision, policy, permission, or validation check.

oneOf.title: Failed
oneOf.description: Execution began or was attempted and did not complete successfully.

oneOf.title: Canceled
oneOf.description: Authority was withdrawn. Cancellation cannot pretend to reverse a completed external effect.

oneOf.title: Expired
oneOf.description: A deadline, lease, response window, or contact budget elapsed first. Expiry is terminal.

effect_state.description: Side-effect certainty, reported independently of the disposition.

oneOf.title: Absent
oneOf.description: No side effect occurred, proven rather than assumed.

oneOf.title: Partial
oneOf.description: Some of the intended effect was applied. Reconciliation resolves the remainder.

oneOf.title: Completed
oneOf.description: The full intended effect was applied.

oneOf.title: Indeterminate
oneOf.description: The effect cannot be proven either way. It enters reconciliation by stable provider identity and is never blindly repeated.
